debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r s-i-g-n-e-d o-f-f the m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e f-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n a-f-t-e-r f-a-i-l-u-r-e o-f q-u-a-l-i-t-y c-o-n-t-r-o-l and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g e-n-t-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
2) the a-c-t-o-r a-p-p-l-i-e-d n-e-w l-a-b-e-l-s to the p-r-o-d-u-c-t p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g to m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t o-r-i-g-i-n a-n-d e-x-p-i-r-y and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a l-a-b-e-l v-e-r-s-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r y f-i-l e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y l-a-b-e-l a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l c-h-e-c-k
3) the a-c-t-o-r a-l-t-e-r-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l i-z-a-t-i-o-n n-u-m-b-e-r-s in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e s-w-a-p and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d s-y-s-t-e-m l-o g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
4) the a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e r-e-a-d-i-n-g-s for the c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a p-r-i-n-t-e-d t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e r-e-p-o-r t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-n-v-i-r-o-n-m-e-n-t-a-l s-e-n-s-o-r c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
5) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d the b-a-t-c-h e-s with p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y p-o-i-n-t-s for s-a-l-e and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l q-u-a-l-i-t-y r-e-l-e-a-s e a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l s-t-e-p
